statement: At seq_len=64, MoR recursion adds 2.08× throughput overhead (No-MoR: 359 tok/s vs Full: 173 tok/s) and -49% VRAM overhead (828→423MB), without statistically significant loss improvement (Full: 3.1425, No-MoR: 3.1365, Welch t=0.9026, Cohen's d=0.737, p>0.10). MoR also reduces gradient explosions (Full: 5 vs No-MoR: 1 events).
evidence_completeness: PARTIAL — requires seq_len>=512 and >200 steps to assess MoR long-context benefit.
architectural_recommendation: Implement Adaptive MoR: depth=0 for seq_len<128, depth=1 for seq_len>=512
